T: A table. A sword lies on it, polished to a mirror. Next to it, a list titled THINGS I AM NOT SCARED OF.
p: A potted fern. Someone has named it Gerald and is clearly scared of it.
W: The Archive's shelves run right through into here.
1: The door back out to the Archive.

objects.name: Brannoc
lines: Ah! Oh, it is you. Come in. Mind the fern. His name is Gerald.
